normalization: Fixed reference crop to 96x132 with nearest-neighbor; alpha threshold 128; exact source-palette restriction. No foreground bbox fitting.
originalPixelReuse: All canonical rows y<160 are byte-identical. Only the generated lower-knee/ankle/shoe region is composited.

selfReview.identity: Exact original head, glasses, face and neck; no generated face or head scaling.
selfReview.armsAndSuit: Exact original pixels eliminate first-draft shortening and pinched waist.
selfReview.knees: Mild flexion joins original upper legs; no visible disconnected knee edge in native and 5x detail review.
selfReview.feet: Lowest shoe pixel y=193, ten pixels above original ground baseline y=203; angled shoes, not planted walking feet.
selfReview.limitation: This is a motion-study base, not user-approved animation. Slight knee flexion changes silhouette height without whole-body scaling.
